fields.name: ExpressionHelpers mapping expression builders
fields.contract: ExpressionHelpers exposes static expression-builder families for query-contract mapping: input and output parameter expressions; reader-property expressions; parameter and field lookup; and virtual-compound-key parameter expansion. Input builders vary by simple, string, enum-backed, and binary values; reader/output builders vary by strings, enums, simple values, binary values, arrays, nullable values, and null-result substitutions. Each family appends executable expression nodes to the caller-provided collection rather than executing the database operation itself.
